scope: bounded deterministic simulation; no source or live UI mutation

strategyDescriptions.blindAttack: Play first affordable attack in hand; ignore all non-attacks and intents.
strategyDescriptions.handOrder: Play first affordable card in hand until none remain.
strategyDescriptions.observeGuard: Observe first, defend announced attacks, prefer guarded riposte; reserve Shura for full analysis or lethal damage.
strategyDescriptions.defenseOnly: Observe and defend only; never play attacks.

uiVictoryRoute.description: Click card IDs in order; end each of the first three turns; final Shura ends the fight.

events.text: 看破生效：本次攻擊穿透魔力護盾。

defenseOnlyExtendedCheck.conclusion: The two 200-turn survivors both eventually lost; no infinite loop was found by this bounded check.

findings: The default seed is beatable in 4 turns with observed guard and a real barrier-piercing attack.
Blind attack won 39 of 40 tested seeds; first-affordable hand-order play won all 40. Current tuning is forgiving and does not require tactical analysis to win.
Full insight penetrated positive barrier in all 40 observe-guard wins; it is reachable in ordinary play.
Empty passing always lost on turn 9.

recommendation.reason: Blind attack wins only 2/40 while observation/defense wins 40/40 in 4–5 turns. B still allows 32/40 blind-attack wins. Both let guarded play retain 70–92 stamina and actually exercise barrier penetration.
recommendation.qualification: This is a bounded deterministic sample, not a global balance proof; first-affordable card-order play remains a simpler alternative than optimized tactics.
recommendation.defaultRoute: T1 insight guard riposte slash; T2 insight slash slash riposte; T3 guard riposte slash; T4 insight shura.
